Hypoxanthine ameliorates diet-induced insulin resistance by improving hepatic lipid metabolism and gluconeogenesis via AMPK/mTOR/PPARα pathway. Insulin resistance (IR) is a pivotal metabolic disorder associated with type 2 diabetes and metabolic syndrome. This study investigated the potential of hypoxanthine (Hx), a purine metabolite and uric acid precursor, in ameliorating IR and regulating hepatic glucose and lipid metabolism.
